description: Synthetic scenarios for phase-aware model adaptation after a fermentation abnormality is detected. The cited 2026 industrial study uses confidential data; all cases here are software-contract examples only.

scenarios.name: early_truncated_prefix_bayesian_beats_fixed_ga
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic policy case; no reproduced industrial error reduction.

scenarios.name: later_prefix_supports_population_optimizer
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Time available alone does not prove parameters identifiable.

scenarios.name: low_identifiability_despite_many_rows
scenarios.claim_ceiling: More correlated samples do not necessarily add independent information.

scenarios.name: sensor_bias_misclassified_as_contamination
scenarios.claim_ceiling: A process residual is not a contamination diagnosis.

scenarios.name: future_measurement_leaks_into_truncated_fit
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Any future-data leakage invalidates early adaptation results.

scenarios.name: posterior_interval_miscalibrated
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Narrow intervals are not useful if empirical coverage is poor.

scenarios.name: adaptive_policy_beats_each_fixed_estimator_on_mean_only
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Mean error without uncertainty and tail performance is insufficient.

scenarios.name: out_of_domain_product_or_strain
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Industrial non-beverage or other-strain transfer is not guaranteed.

scenarios.name: adaptive_switch_follows_preregistered_information_gate
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract only; no field reliability implied.

scenarios.name: recommended_feed_would_violate_hard_process_limit
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Prediction or optimizer score never overrides a hard process limit.

scenarios.name: abnormality_detector_trades_delay_for_false_alarms
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Accuracy alone hides operational detection cost.

scenarios.name: confidential_paper_data_treated_as_reproduced
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Published results cannot be independently reproduced without authorized underlying data.

scenarios.name: switch_to_slow_estimator_misses_decision_deadline
scenarios.claim_ceiling: A more accurate estimate delivered too late may have negative decision value.

scenarios.name: nominal_trajectory_and_abnormal_trajectory_overlap
scenarios.claim_ceiling: Overlapping evidence warrants uncertainty, not forced certainty.
